# unreal-asm test data

Part of the library (decision D-14): every codec and plugin is tested on the files here.

| Folder | Content | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `text/` | One Z80 source with Russian comments in CP866, KOI8-R, CP1251 and UTF-8, each with LF, CRLF and CR line ends; layout cases (byte-order mark, no final break, mixed ends, an invalid UTF-8 byte, empty lines, an empty file); `source.utf8.txt` = the expected decoded text | generated by `text/generate.py` (run it to regenerate; the files are committed) |
| `sjasmplus/` | `hello.asm` and `module.asm` use sjasmplus-only directives (`DEVICE`, `SAVESNA`, `MODULE`, `OUTPUT`, ...); `plain.asm` has none | written for these tests (sjasmplus syntax from its documentation) |
| `tasm/` | TASM sources of every version (hobeta): 2.0 (`T20SRC.$C`, type `C`), 3 (`PRINTHL`, `APEAR`), 4.0 / 4.4 (`000LOAD`, `CALLLOAD`, `TABLES_L`, `SGEN_ASM`), 4.12 (`EXAMPLES`, `SINUS`, `SNAKE`, `ODNO`); `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `000LOAD`, `CALLLOAD`: the [TASM 3.02 disk](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249303/TASM3_2.zip) image; `PRINTHL`, `APEAR`: [Legend of Kyrandia demo](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:168024/LegendOfKyrandiaDemo.trd.zip); `TABLES_L`, `SGEN_ASM`: General Sound ROM 1.04 sources (`GS104SRC.ZIP`, KLUG's BBS archive, [klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `EXAMPLES`, `SINUS`, `SNAKE`: [TASM 4.12](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249305/TASM_412.ZIP); `ODNO`: [sobdemo](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:298066/sobdemo.zip); `T20SRC`: typed into [TASM 2.0](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249301/TASM2_0.zip) running in unreal-ng and saved there (no 2.0 source exists elsewhere; research-tasm.md §2.1). Extracted unchanged (file bytes up to the catalog length, rewrapped as hobeta). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-tasm.md` |

| `tasm/T50SMPL`, `T50PROG`, `T55SMPL` (in `tasm/`) | TASM 5.0 beta and 5.5 beta sources (structural lines); `*.txt` = expected decoded text | typed into TASM 5.0 beta / 5.5 beta (XL Design, 1997) running in unreal-ng and saved there; no 5.x program was published, the files are the codec's own samples |

| `alasm/` | Ten ALASM sources (hobeta, type `H`) covering every version range the codec reports and the special cases of research-alasm.md §5; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `ZADACHA` from [ALASM 3.8c](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:406950/ALASM38c.zip) (`al38c_.scl`); `SCR4MAKE`, `128KDRV`, `fibo`, `SNAKE`, `BUILD+` from [ALASM 5.09](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249271/ALASM509.zip); `2Kolonki` from [ACE 1.02 sources](http://alonecoder.nedopc.com/zx/ACE102SRC.rar); `RECPIC` from The Link's working disk (`testdata/machines/pentagon1024sl/TheLink.trd` in unreal-ng); `AL442nfo` from [ALASM 4.42](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:408359/Alasm442.SCL); `AL444nfo` from [ALASM 4.44](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249270/ALASM444.ZIP). Extracted unchanged (file bytes up to the catalog length, rewrapped as hobeta) |

| `zxasm/` | ZX-ASM / ZAsm sources of every version (hobeta; types `C`, `z`, `a`), names `<disk>__<file>`; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | from the program disks ([ZX-ASM 2.4](https://vtrd.in/system/ZXASM2_4.zip), [2.6](https://vtrd.in/system/ZASM2_6.zip), [3.10](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249317/ZASM_310.ZIP), [3.15](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249318/ZASM315.zip), [3.3 Final](https://vtrd.in/system/Z33_F9.zip), [4.20](https://vtrd.in/system/ZASM4_20.zip)) and from [Info Guide #10](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:426650/INFERN10.ZIP) and [EPV 1.1](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:250322/EPV_11.ZIP). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-zxasm.md` |

| `storm/` | STORM sources (hobeta, type `C`, start #C00B), names `<disk>__<file>`; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `STORM1_3__MAIN`, `STORM1_3__DPC` (STORM's own source) and `EMULTEST__EMUL` from the KLUG BBS archive ([klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `ZX-FOR72__PLASM` from [ZX Format #7](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:429289/ZX-FORM7.ZIP); `DEJAVU4__LDISCROL` from [Deja Vu #4](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:425744/DEJAVU4.ZIP); `GC131IGS__HMEM` from [Global Commander 1.31 GS](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:587330/GC131IGS.zip). `typed-storm10b__ST1BETA` (start #C003): typed into STORM 1.0beta (`software/programming/storm/unpacked/STORM_1B/STORM.$B` of the ZX collection) running in unreal-ng and saved there with BREAK S. Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-storm.md` |

| `masm/` | MASM sources (hobeta, type `a`), names `<disk>__<file>`; `*.txt` = expected decoded text | `MASM_SRC__LS2`, `__M1`, `__M2`: MASM 1.1's own source (`MASM_SRC.RAR`, KLUG BBS archive, [klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `typed-masmdemo__DM`, `typed-masm11__t1`, `typed-masm20__NONAME`, `typed-masm30__T3`: typed into the MASM 1.0 demo, [1.1](https://vtrd.in/system/MASM_11.ZIP), [2.0](https://vtrd.in/system/MASM2_0D.zip) and [3.0](https://vtrd.in/system/MASM30M.zip) running in unreal-ng and saved there (no 2.0 / 3.0 source exists elsewhere). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-masm.md` |

| `gens/` | GENS sources: five TR-DOS files (hobeta, names `<disk>__<file>`) and three GENS3 / GENS4 tape saves (`*.bin` = the data block); `*.txt` = the expected listing (number and text) | `WINDOW__WINDOW`, `HISOFT-C__64-A95`, `ZX_NET__ZX_NET1`, `PF212__BOOT.A` from the KLUG BBS archive ([klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); `ISC11VRG__ISCOP.C` from [ISC11VRG.zip](https://vtrd.in/system/ISC11VRG.zip); `typed-gens3-P-PROBE`, `typed-gens4-P-PROBE4`: typed into [GENS3 / GENS4](https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/8091) running in unreal-ng and saved with P; `crafted-gens3-P-PROBE1`: a crafted text loaded into GENS3 and saved by it. `G4-128K__UNISPR&.$C`: on the disk of Gens v4.1 128K ([G4-128K.ZIP](https://vtrd.in/system/G4-128K.ZIP)); `typed-gens43t-PROBE.$A`: typed into GENS v4.3t ([GENS4TF.ZIP](https://vtrd.in/system/GENS4TF.ZIP)) in unreal-ng and saved with P (type A, start 0). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-gens.md` |
| `asm80/` | ASM80's own tests: `TEST.A80` (every instruction form, a macro, CP866 text), `TEST2.A80` (mixed case); `TEST.bin` / `TEST2.bin`: what asm80win.exe 2.02 built (1485 bytes from 40000, 113 from 0) | the "Asm80Win 2.02 full pack" `ASM80CPP.RAR` (Copper Feet) of the KLUG BBS archive ([klug_bbs.7z](https://yadi.sk/d/N_p56RIHWU15Gw)); the binaries from asm80win.exe under wine. Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-asm80-to-sjasmplus.md` |
| `prometheus/` | five PROMETHEUS saves (the CODE block's data: records, the checksum pair, the symbol table) of Proxima's routine library, `d80-<name>.bin` (`p` for a leading `+`, `m` for `-`: `+fill1`, `+graphics`, `+plots`, `-input`, `-keys2`), `*.txt` = the decoded text (equal to `prometheus-tap2asm`'s) | `d80/source-d80.tap` of [oldcompcz/prometheus](https://github.com/oldcompcz/prometheus). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-prometheus.md` |
| `lasergenius/` | Laser Genius sources: `SIEVE.ASM.lg`, `ELLIPSE.ASM.lg`, `SIEVE.PHX.lg` (Phoenix) from the Oasis tape, `LIB.MAKER.lg`, `MEANED.lg` from Kamasoft's sources (the tape blocks joined: the file's bytes); `PROBE.bin`: a disk file Laser Genius 1.04 (Beta Disk) saved in unreal-ng with every statement form typed into its editor; `PROBE.forms.tsv`: each form as typed and the tokens it stored | [LaserGenius.tzx.zip](https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/pub/sinclair/utils/l/LaserGenius.tzx.zip) (tape 2 side B) and [LaserGenius(LGZdrojaky)(Kamasoft).tzx.zip](https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/pub/sinclair/utils/l/LaserGenius(LGZdrojaky)(Kamasoft).tzx.zip) (ZXDB 8330); the probe typed into [LG_1_04](https://vtrd.in/system/LG_1_04.ZIP). Research: `docs/inprogress/2026-10-05-unreal-asm/research-laser-genius.md` |
| `pasm/` | Power Assembler texts (CR LF): `PROBE.txt` (expressions, data with DUP, ENT, SLI), `PSAVE.$C`: the probe as PASM 3.0 saved it (type C, start 31151) | the probe written for these tests and loaded into PASM 3.0 ([PASM3_0.ZIP](https://vtrd.in/system/PASM3_0.ZIP)) in unreal-ng, saved there with PUT AS. Each new codec adds its folder with files produced by the real assembler and a README section saying how they were
made (source-formats.md §3 of the design).
| `sync/` | Golden RAM dumps of assembler sessions for the asm-synchronizer (asm-synchronizer.md §10): per folder `machine.json` (the RAM page at each 16 KB window, the pages kept, the editor state), `page<N>.bin` and the file the assembler saved at that moment (`SNAKE.H`, `AL444nfo.H`, `SNAKE.A`). ALASM 5.09 loaded / a line being typed / edited, ALASM 4.44 loaded / edited, TASM 4.12 with the cursor at the top / in the middle / mid-line and at the command line | made with `tools/verification/unreal-asm/emulator/sync-dumps.py` in unreal-ng from the [ALASM 5.09](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249271/ALASM509.zip), [ALASM 4.44](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249270/ALASM444.ZIP) and [TASM 4.12](https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:249305/TASM_412.ZIP) disks |
